_readme: Sample answer file for the interactive tasks in workload-domain-recovery-plan.json, consumed via Import-VCFIRAnswerFile.

Keyed by cmdlet name. Each value is an array of answer sets - one answer set per invocation of that cmdlet in the plan (New-NSXManagerOvaDeployment runs up to 3 times: First/Second/Third NSX Manager OVA Deployment).
Each answer set is an ordered array of the values you would otherwise type at that cmdlet's Read-Host prompts, in the same order the prompts appear.

The exact number of prompts (and so the length of each answer set) depends on your environment's discovered NIC/disk/VDS counts - the values below match a common 1-VDS, single-disk-group, 3-NSX-Manager workload domain and MUST be reviewed against your own environment's prompts before use.
Run each task interactively once first to see its real prompts/IDs, then transcribe your answers here in the same order. An invalid or missing answer fails the run immediately rather than hanging.

New-RebuiltVsanDatastore prompts only apply to vSAN OSA. For vSAN ESA it asks nothing at all, but the cmdlet still requires its key to be present - use an empty answer set, e.g. "New-RebuiltVsanDatastore": [[]], to declare 'one invocation, zero answers needed' for an ESA environment.
New-RebuiltVdsConfiguration asks for one comma-separated NIC list per VDS discovered on the reference host, then a final Y/N - the sample below assumes a single VDS.
This key is ignored by Import-VCFIRAnswerFile - only the cmdlet-name keys below are read.
